title: Product Management
summary: Commercial property insurance products cover buildings, stock, and related business personal property, with standard-peril coverage and optional specialized extensions to address asset-specific risks. The development process follows a structured lifecycle: market research and benchmarking, actuarial pricing and profitability assessment, regulatory/compliance checks, and final executive approvals before product launch.
